verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance has a public OAuth-authenticated API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. Idempotency keys and explicitly granted write capabilities are related safety controls, not isolation from production data, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
